title: Tree of Life (Kohbar)
description: Exquisite Mithila/Madhubani masterpiece rendered with natural pigments, twigs, and fine nib pens on handmade lokta paper. Celebrates harmony, fertility, and cosmological continuity with intricate fish and peacocks interwoven across sacred branches.
medium: Natural Dyes & Pigments on Handmade Lokta Paper

title: Celestial Ganesha
description: Classical Thanjavur (Tanjore) sacred portrait embossed with relief gesso paste, adorned with genuine 22-carat gold foil leafing and semi-precious Jaipur stones on treated teakwood board.
medium: 22K Gold Foil, Semi-Precious Stones & Gesso on Teakwood

title: Monsoon Over the Ghats
description: Vibrant contemporary modernist interpretation of twilight over the sacred Varanasi riverfront during heavy monsoon downpours. Built with thick textural palette knife impasto and golden ochre reflections.
medium: Acrylic & Impasto Medium on Stretched Canvas

title: Dusk at Chettinad Courtyard
description: Atmospheric plein-air watercolor depicting the tranquil pillared verandah of an antique ancestral mansion in Tamil Nadu, capturing ambient warm light filtering through stone jali screens.
medium: Winsor & Newton Artist Watercolors on 300gsm Arches Cold Press Paper

title: Resonance of the Raga (Bhairavi)
description: Large-format expressive abstraction translating classical Indian morning ragas into rhythmically stratified tonal fields of crimson, cadmium yellow, and raw umber.

title: The Lotus Pond of Mandu
description: Poetic balance between traditional miniature aesthetics and modern lyrical realism, capturing drifting pink lotus blossoms against emerald shadows on tranquil historical reservoir waters.
medium: Acrylic and Gold Powder on Canvas
